home.headline: What's happening on Earth right now?
home.intro: Public USGS, NASA, NOAA, CelesTrak, OpenSky and Open-Meteo data combined in a single live view.
home.phase1Notice: Phase 1 live: USGS quakes + switchable NASA GIBS tiles + terminator. Satellites, aircraft, weather, FIRMS, EONET, ISS still to come.
home.overlayOnly2D: GIBS / Lightning / Radar overlays are available only in 2D map view — switch to 2D from the toggle above.
home.perfFallbackInfo: 3D performance not optimal on your device: switched automatically to 2D map. You can retry 3D from the toggle.

aircraft.title: OpenSky aircraft
aircraft.subtitle: Real-time ADS-B states from the OpenSky network
aircraft.heading: Heading
aircraft.incertitude: Best-effort ADS-B data, coverage depends on the OpenSky receiver network.
aircraft.outOfView: Pan/zoom: the aircraft is outside the viewport or no longer tracked.
aircraft.viewportCapped: Showing the 500 aircraft closest to the map center.

eonet.title: EONET natural events
eonet.subtitle: Active events tracked by NASA EONET v3
eonet.empty: No active events with the current filters.
eonet.incertitude: Best-effort events. Initial positions may be imprecise; updates depend on NASA EONET providers.
eonet.selectFromMap: Click an event on the map to open its detail panel.

iss.title: ISS live
iss.subtitle: International Space Station in real time
iss.passesIntro: Computed with SGP4 at 60 s steps, 10° minimum elevation, 48 h window.
iss.passesEmpty: No pass above 10° in the next 48 h from this location.
iss.incertitude: Pass predictions: typical ±10 s uncertainty in LEO. Depends on TLE freshness.
iss.tleMissing: TLE not available — try again when back online.

fires.title: Active fires
fires.subtitle: NASA FIRMS thermal hotspots · NRT
fires.empty: No hotspots in the current viewport.
fires.missingKeyBody: We're showing the GIBS Active Fires fallback (daily, not real-time). Get a free personal map key to enable NRT.
fires.notInViewport: The selected hotspot left the viewport or temporal window.
fires.attribution: Hotspots: NASA FIRMS / EOSDIS · Fallback: NASA GIBS
fires.incertitude: Hotspots detected from satellite, not ground-confirmed. Confidence indicates probability of real fire vs reflection/other.

lightning.title: Lightning
lightning.subtitle: Global mean flash density (LIS / TRMM climatology)
lightning.mvpBanner: Static MVP — global mean lightning density. Live Blitzortung WebSocket in v1.1.
lightning.detailIntro: v1.0 shows a climatological density map (events/year/km²). Individual strikes are not queryable — they'll arrive in v1.1 via Blitzortung WebSocket.
lightning.detailBullet1: Source: NASA LIS/TRMM (1998–2014) + ISS-LIS, coverage ±38° lat with polar fade.
lightning.detailBullet2: Hottest zones: Central Africa, Indonesia, Florida, Congo basin.
lightning.detailBullet3: v1.1 will overlay live strikes while keeping this tile as climatological backdrop.

about.title: About EarthRadar
about.intro: EarthRadar is an educational PWA in the PezzaliAPP family. It answers the question "what's happening on Earth right now?" by combining public USGS, NASA, NOAA, CelesTrak, OpenSky and Open-Meteo data.
about.sisterIntro: EarthRadar is part of the PezzaliAPP Earth & Space trilogy:
about.sources: USGS · NASA GIBS · NASA FIRMS · NASA EONET · NASA EPIC · CelesTrak · OpenSky Network · Open-Meteo · RainViewer · wheretheiss.at · OpenStreetMap

disclaimer.title: EarthRadar — Notice
disclaimer.body: Educational tool based on public USGS, NASA, NOAA, CelesTrak, OpenSky, Open-Meteo data. It does NOT replace official civil-protection, air-navigation, seismology, operational meteorology or planetary-defense systems. Satellite positions are propagated from public TLEs (typical km-level uncertainty in LEO).
disclaimer.short: Educational tool. Does not replace official operational systems.
